DIAGNOSIS READY: Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma

Given your age, history of sunbathing, and the location of the lesion on the dorsal hand, I am highly suspicious for a skin cancer. Please describe the specific appearance of the rash (e.g., is it a scaly patch, a raised bump, or ulcerated?) and whether it has been growing, bleeding, or changing in color recently.
